name: Yuubari
source:
A pseudo A.I created by Hiraga that acts as the brain of a battleship. Cannot be massed produced as the core uses the rare material purple hirara. Has an innocent child like mind. Likes: sortieing, riddles. Dislikes: the post perovskite phase.

(From in-game bio)
